value.rationale: Complete k-ary type and orbit counts in a natural mixed-exponent family yield exact expressivity loss (a rapidly growing index), a sharp order-eight minimal unary witness, and a five-case classification of precisely which local subgroup embeddings split under ambient automorphisms. The exact numbers are a motivated benchmark for qf-definability algorithms involving finite abelian groups; they are not merely computational recitations or arbitrary finite slices.
